messages:
Diego (PM): Quick follow-up from this morning's all-hands Q&A 16 can product leads confirm timelines for API rate-limit tiers, Console per-route dashboards, and Optimize recommendations rollout? Trying to plan Q3/Q4 deliverables.
Samira (CTO): Short answer: API rate-limit tiers (internal soft launch) targeted mid-August; public rollout late September. Console per-route dashboards aiming for Beta in October. Optimize recommendations (model + quantization suggestions) target preview in November. Will publish exact milestones after product sync.
Alex Kim: About API rate-limit tiers: are we adding per-route quotas or just new account plans? Need clarity for SDK changes.
Samira (CTO): Both. Account-level tiers and per-route overrides. SDK impact should be small; we'll add an optional header `x-rw-limit-tier` for telemetry. @Alex Kim I'll send spec by Friday EOD.
Marie Chen: For Console per-route dashboards: will we have token-level cost breakdown and retention windows?
Priya (Eng Lead): Yes: token-level cost, per-route P50/P95 latency, and error rates. Default retention 90 days; enterprise opt-in 365. Note: backend analytics pipeline work may affect GA if issues arise.
Jordan (SRE): Any SLO adjustments with new rate-limit tiers? Need fallback behavior for large tenants.
Samira (CTO): Fallback plan: soft-throttling -> switch to smaller model variant -> 429 when burst pool exhausted. We'll provide a runbook. @Jordan let's sync on capacity thresholds.
Diego (PM): Regarding Optimize: will it proactively suggest quantization profiles or just show estimates?
Priya (Eng Lead): Phase 1 = suggestions with cost/latency estimates. Phase 2 (H1 2026) aims for automated quantized deploys for Dedicated. November preview will be manual-apply only.
Alex Kim: Will there be migration guides so SDKs can surface new options?
Marie Chen: Yes, we'll prepare customer-facing one-pager and migration docs.
Samira (CTO): @Diego can you draft the customer one-pager? We'll iterate.
Diego (PM): Will do. Draft by Tuesday.
release-bot: deploy notice: canary for console analytics pipeline started 2024-08-02T19:20:00Z
Jordan (SRE): If canary shows >5% ingestion errors, pause and roll back.
Priya (Eng Lead): Canary config:
```
canary:
  traffic: 10%
  window: 72h
  abort_if: ingestion_error_rate >= 0.05
```
Samira (CTO): Thanks everyone. We'll confirm dates in tomorrow's product leadership sync. :rocket:
